description: Send one signed test event (type watchlist.test) to your alert webhook and, if email alerts are on, a test email, and report whether each was delivered. Nothing is retried. Limited to 5 per hour. With no webhook set and email alerts off, nothing is sent and the result says what to set up. Scoped to your account: needs sign-in (/mcp/account) or an API key. Free.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text answer. full returns the complete JSON as text. The structured result is the same either way.

name: wallet_watchlist_test_alert

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.
